name: stitchify
description: Browser extension and web studio to capture, vertically stitch, annotate, and export screenshots as PNG or PDF.

scripts.package: npm run build && npx web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:source: mkdir -p artifacts && zip -r artifacts/source-code.zip README.md src public index.html editor.html popup.html sidepanel.html package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts tailwind.config.js postcss.config.js -x "node_modules/*" "dist/*" ".git/*"
